proposed_backend: systemd user slice / cgroup v2 CPU quota

configure.aggregate_cpu_percent: 100 means one CPU's time; apply to a shared slice

run.argv: launch a job into that shared slice

stop.behavior: remove the quota without terminating workloads

required_guarantees: All launched descendant processes inherit the same shared quota
Codex/Claude app-server jobs must be explicitly launched/adopted into the slice
Do not imply that already-running jobs were adopted when only a slice was configured
Agent/terminal input handling must stay outside the workload slice
Discover CPU topology; never assume six efficiency cores on Linux
